judgments.rationale: The first three sources are described as autonomous research-agent frameworks for scientific research pipelines (Autonomous Research Loops: entire life cycle/end-to-end workflows; EvoScientist: multi-agent AI scientist for end-to-end scientific discovery; Heuresis: autonomous AI research framework over the research pipeline). The other three are described as evidence-grounding or verification systems (CliVER: scientific claim verification; Evidence Coverage Evaluator: evidence-coverage/grounding assessment for RAG answers; RefLens: evidence-grounded citation verification). This supports the claimed separation between those two prior-work groups.
